stories.headline: Russia fires 656 drones and 73 missiles at Ukraine, killing at least 18 in Kyiv and Dnipro

key_facts.fact: Russia launched 656 strike drones and 73 missiles overnight June 1-2 including ballistic, cruise and anti-ship variants
key_facts.excerpt: Russia launched 656 strike drones and 73 missiles overnight June 1-2, 2026

key_facts.fact: At least 12 people were killed in Dnipro, including an 8-year-old boy pulled from the rubble of a collapsed four-story apartment building
key_facts.excerpt: 12 killed in Dnipro including an 8-year-old boy pulled from rubble

key_facts.fact: Six people were killed in Kyiv with more than 100 injured nationwide
key_facts.excerpt: 6 killed in Kyiv; More than 100 people injured nationwide

key_facts.fact: Ukrainian defenses downed 40 of 73 missiles and 602 of 656 drones, with 38 sites hit
key_facts.excerpt: 40 of 73 missiles and 602 of 656 drones downed or neutralized; 38 sites hit

key_facts.excerpt: Russia used hypersonic missiles in what it called a 'massive strike' on Ukrainian military-industrial complex

stories.headline: Brent jumps near $100 on Iran-Hormuz risk as Fed rate cuts priced out for 2026

Traders now price zero Fed rate cuts in 2026 with positioning tilted toward a potential hike

stories.headline: FDA approves Shionogi's XOCOVA, the first oral antiviral for COVID-19 post-exposure prevention

key_facts.fact: The FDA approved Shionogi's XOCOVA (ensitrelvir) on June 1 as the first and only oral antiviral for post-exposure prophylaxis of COVID-19
key_facts.excerpt: FDA approval announced June 1, 2026; First oral PEP option for COVID-19 in the US

key_facts.fact: XOCOVA is a 3CL protease inhibitor approved for adults and adolescents 12 and older
key_facts.excerpt: Approved for adults and adolescents 12 years and older

key_facts.fact: The five-day regimen is three tablets on day 1, then one tablet on days 2-5
key_facts.excerpt: Five-day regimen: 3 tablets day 1, 1 tablet days 2-5

key_facts.fact: FDA approved ahead of the June 16 PDUFA action date; XOCOVA is already approved in Japan for treatment and prevention
key_facts.excerpt: Approved ahead of PDUFA date of June 16, 2026; Already approved in Japan for both treatment and prevention
